shortdesc.ph: Used to configure local audio mixing.
The configurations for mixing the local audio.

plentry.pd: The number of audio streams for local mixing.
The source of audio streams for local mixing. See .

Whether the mixed audio stream uses the timestamp of audio frames captured by the local microphone.
: (default) Use the timestamp of audio frames captured by the local microphone. Set this value if you want all locally captured audio streams to be synchronized.
: Use the timestamp of audio frames during mixing.
Sources of the local mixed audio stream. See .

Whether the mixed audio stream uses the timestamp of audio frames captured by the local mic.
(default): Yes. Recommended if you want all locally captured audio streams to be processed synchronously.
: No. The SDK uses the timestamp generated during mixing.
The number of the audio streams that are mixed locally.
The source of the audio streams that are mixed locally. See .

Whether the mxied audio stream uses the timestamp of the audio frames captured by the local microphone.
: (Default) Yes. Set to this value if you want all locally captured audio streams synchronized.
: No. The SDK uses the timestamp of the audio frames at the time when they are mixed.
